item.title: The Website Rebuild Step That Saves the Whole Project
item.description: A website rebuild should not start with colors, animations, or page mockups. It should start with an inventory: what exists, what matters, what should be reused, and what needs to change.

item.title: The Typo That Silently Breaks Your Static Site (And How to Catch It)
item.description: Static site generators fail gracefully — sometimes too gracefully. A wrong frontmatter key produces no error, no warning, just a missing feature. Here’s how to debug it and what to do about it.
